userStories.title: Build adaptive question selector service
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the core adaptive selection algorithm that replaces ORDER BY RANDOM() with intelligent question selection based on user performance, cooldown, and difficulty progression.
acceptanceCriteria: Create services/adaptiveSelector.ts with selectQuestions(params) function
Weak area weighting: <70% accuracy gets 3x, <50% gets 5x, 0 attempts gets 2x, >90% with 10+ attempts gets 0.5x
Cooldown enforcement: exclude recently-seen questions (default window 30), auto-shrink if pool too small
Difficulty progression: bias easy for beginners (<50%), balanced for intermediate (50-75%), bias hard for advanced (>75%)
Fallback to RANDOM() when adaptive pool insufficient
Returns array of question IDs in randomized order
Unit tests cover weak area weighting, cooldown exclusion, difficulty progression, sparse pool fallback
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Build difficulty calibration service with Bayesian threshold
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a service that recalculates question difficulty based on actual user performance using Bayesian confidence scaling.
acceptanceCriteria: Create services/difficultyCalibration.ts with updateQuestionStats(questionId, isCorrect)
Add recalibrateIfReady(questionId) with Bayesian threshold: min 5 attempts, confidence = 1 - 1/sqrt(sampleSize)
Blended difficulty: (1 - confidence) * original + confidence * empirical
Empirical mapping: >80% correct = easy, 50-80% = medium, <50% = hard
Add getCalibratedDifficulty(questionId) with fallback to original
Unit tests cover threshold behavior, confidence scaling, blending formula
Typecheck passes
